description: Connects the host's own live streaming account so the webinar room can stream: 100ms or Daily.co. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site. The credentials are stored on the site and apply to EVERY webinar on it, not only the one in this chat, so say that in one sentence before you write. Needs `session_id` and `provider`. For 100ms pass `app_access_key` and `app_secret` from the 100ms developer settings, or a `management_token`; for Daily pass `api_key` and `domain`. `template_id` and `subdomain` belong to 100ms, `region` to Daily. With `webinar_id` the campaign is switched onto that provider at the same time, and `create_room` true creates its room right away. Never invent a key: only what the host gave you. Read the state first with wi_get_streaming_status.

api_key.description: Daily: the API key from the Daily dashboard.

app_access_key.description: 100ms: the App Access Key from the 100ms developer settings.

app_secret.description: 100ms: the App Secret. Stored encrypted on the site.

create_room.description: true creates the webinar's room right away.

domain.description: Daily: the domain of the account.

management_token.description: 100ms: a manually pasted management token, as a fallback when no app credentials are set.

region.description: Daily: the region the rooms should run in.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

template_id.description: 100ms: the template id from the 100ms dashboard.

use_global.description: 100ms: true uses the install-wide defaults, false keeps the campaign's own.

video.description: Only with webinar_id: the video source to set, 100ms or embed.

webinar_id.description: Switch this webinar onto the provider in the same call.

name: wi_connect_streaming
title: Connect the live streaming account
